notes.title: Major update: Now fully compatible with Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Martians![/h2]

We have big news! On Mars, We have been working on a secret project these last months:
Mutropolis is now fully compatible with the gamepad of the Steam Deck and can be played with touch. It also now supports playing the game with gamepad on Windows and macOs. 

We've been testing it with the help of [b]M.A.X.[/b] It's not easy to press all those little buttons when you have tiny, mechanical hands. Not to mention the rambling feedback received by our little robot. All his notes started with [i]"Not enough cat memes"[/i].

But we finally got it ready for release. [b]Mutropolis now fully supports the Steam Deck.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/16faaf7f0fd6a90c40b2076a6801e8a0a5a5ef2f.jpg[/img]

Yours,
Bea & Pablo

notes.title: Mutropolis Wins Best Traditional Adventure in the Aggie Awards! 🏆
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martians![/h2]

We're full of the warm and fuzzies today - no, not because we've been sneaking Totel's secret stash of 'mulled champagne' again - but because Mutropolis has won the award for the Best Traditional Adventure Game in the Aggie Awards, presented by [url=https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/the-aggie-awards-the-best-adventure-games-of-2021/page16]AdventureGamers.com[/url]. 

Hmm, maybe we need that mulled champagne after all! 

The team at Adventure Gamers stated that Mutropolis has been able to [i]'tap into the best elements of the past while benefiting from everything the present has to offer'.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/f299dc06e00a589c518fcf7cc54f54f0ad8a988c.jpg[/img]

It's [i]'a game that proves there's still a wealth of riches to be excavated from the point-and-click format and offers plenty of hope for what lies ahead.'[/i]

High praise indeed, and we are incredibly thankful for their kind words! Read their full post here, and take a look at all the other winners from various categories. 



This isn't the only thing we're celebrating though... Spring is almost here and it's almost time to hang up the coats and gloves. 🧤🧥 That's why.... It's time for pre-spring announcements!

[h3]Mutropolis Gets Trading Cards[/h3]

Trading cards and community items are coming to Mutropolis on Steam! It's a long-awaited feature from many of the community here and we're really pleased to share a number of awesome trading cards and other items for you to collect. Take a look at some of these samples below! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/048fcfc42325931195cd352aa6601eb320f03c46.jpg[/img]

In the set you will find:
[list]
[*]Exclusive new backgrounds, full of adorable relics from a world before the apocalypse.
[*]The badges, shiny medals for the brave archaeologist. 
[*]Trading cards, cute images of our beloved characters in action.
[*]And 5 brand new emoticons. Harolyn, the mighty guardian of Mutropolis and emoticons speaker, asked us for them months ago. She wanted to expand her vocabulary. 😎🤨😗
[/list]

We hope you enjoy them as much as we have enjoyed making them! You already have them available in Steam and they will pop up as you play the game or right away if your recorded play time has been long enough.


[h3]Mutropolis In The Women's Day Sale[/h3]

Lastly, if you've been holding off on Mutropolis and perhaps looking for the right time to buy, now's your chance! Mutropolis will be -30% from March 7th - 11th (2022... not 5022) in the Women's Day Sale!


Thanks everyone, and here's wishing you all the best during these very strange times in which we live.

notes.title: Major update: New *hotspots* function
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Martians![/h2]

You asked, and we delivered! With the newest update, [i]you’ll be able to press the space bar when feeling lost, and the game will automatically [b]highlight spots[/b] that you can interact with. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/00541cb9149458d892b94689d746205109d2b418.gif[/img]
We didn’t implement a highlight function for launch because we thought most hotspots were relatively easy to locate. However, we agree with you that it’s always best to be able to double-check and make sure you haven’t missed anything important. We believe that every click should carry weight and propel the story forward. Pixel hunting isn’t fun, and we certainly don’t want Mutropolis to be a hunt-the-pixel game. 

[b]Remember[/b]: As you progress in Mutropolis, new hotspots will appear in areas you’ve visited before. If you’d rather discover everything on your own, just avoid hitting the [b]space bar[/b]. ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/5f0409b6c85761c59a3b6b2520d6094b5dc53d39.jpg[/img]

Here are some more fixes that will also go live with the new update:
[list]
    [*]Sound improvements and adjustments
    [*]An animation fix
    [*]Correction of a few typos in various languages
    [*]Menu interface improvements
[/list]
For our friends using [b]Linux[/b]: We’re sorry there’s no fix for full-screen mode yet, but we haven’t forgotten about you. We’re still chasing Visionaire for that engine fix, and we will implement it as a Linux-only bug fix when we have it. 

Thank you for your continuous support and happy puzzle-solving!

Yours,
Bea & Pablo

notes.title: Only 6 Days Left Until Launch!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Martians,[/h2]

Our heroes have made it to Earth safely, but there’s still plenty of time to spare before their adventure officially begins on the 18th.

[i]“It’s still an awfully wet planet. Yes, it’s worse than I remember.” [/i]

Those were Totel’s first words as he stepped out of the spaceship. He’s still adjusting, albeit slowly—he’ll be fine. Cobra meticulously sharpened her knives before hitting the gym. Carlata had a mini meltdown in front of everyone and is still locked in the toilet. Henry is already out and about, watching birds and searching for rare artifacts—no surprise here.

Time is on our side. We want to take this opportunity to talk a bit about how [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037120/Mutropolis/]Mutropolis[/url] came to be. 💡

[hr][/hr]

[h3]A Futuristic Retrospective[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/daafaefc30b8fc3e1040fcfcb974a8237c684416.jpg[/img]

Mutropolis was a project born of passion. Five years ago, Pablo and I set to create something great that we could both be proud of. We soon realized we wanted to make our very own full and complete game. Mutropolis just clicked, and the rest is history. Of course, at the time, we had no idea what we were getting ourselves into, [i]but isn’t that always part of the charm?[/i]

With just a few sketches at hand (and 0 programming experience), we set out to create a lovely sci-fi game that would—[i]hopefully[/i]—capture people’s hearts. The plan was simple: We would create the whole thing ourselves—between the two of us—sharing the workload and cutting down on costs. 

But a game engine can only get you so far; one of us would eventually have to learn how to code. Pablo was already interested in programming and rose to the challenge (even though he was the one with the Fine Arts background). While he kept himself busy with algorithms and endless lines of code, I was drawing and animating non-stop. Admittedly, it wasn’t the most practical of approaches, but we made it work—and had tons of fun in the process!

[h3]The Final Countdown[/h3]

Two years ago, we released the [url=https://pirita-studio.itch.io/mars-episodes-1]Mutropolis ‘Mars Episodes’[/url] on [b]Itch.io[/b], giving fans a taste of what was to come. We received warm feedback, and that pushed us to try even harder.

Eventually, we signed with a publisher, [b]Application Systems Heidelberg[/b]. They helped us with the next big step: marketing the game and bringing it to new audiences.
 
Most recently, we’ve been hard at work trying to add[b] full voiceover[/b] with a whole cast of talented actors—mission accomplished! Now, we are crushing the final bugs and are almost ready for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/902a1805ef00a3db34fa232250107660d11c3e03.gif[/img]
[i]*Final bugs being crushed[/i]

In less than a week, Mutropolis will launch on Steam. 🚀
👏 We’re super-excited and can’t wait to share [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037120/Mutropolis/]our game[/url] with all of you!

Don’t forget, there’s still time to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1037120/announcements/detail/3044965941456017169]create your own adorable MAX papercraft[/url], and share with us on social media. Our favourites may just [b]win themselves a copy of the game for free![/b] 

Stay Awesome,
Bea & Pablo

notes.title: MAG 2020 - Mutropolis: New Demo out! - Fully voiced
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Martians! [/h2]

To celebrate the start of the Steam Autumn sale, we are once again making the Mutropolis demo available on our Steam page for a limited time. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037120/Mutropolis//]Download it here on the game page[/url]				

[h2][b]This time around, however, there are some changes![/b]
[/h2][list]
[*] The demo is now fully voiced in English, featuring the talents of all our incredible voice actors whom you may have seen on our social media.
[*] The new demo is now playable in multiple languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Portuguese (BR) and Russian! 
[/list]
The demo joins Henry and the archaeological team early in the game as they begin their search for Mutropolis on Earth in the year 5000!

[b]If you’ve played a previous version[/b] of the demo before, during another event, do please check it out again with the new voices. IT FEELS LIKE A WHOLE NEW GAME as characters come alive with incredible voice over!

Let us know what you think in the Steam Community or on social media: 
[url=https://twitter.com/Pirita_Studio]Pirita Studio Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/piritastudio/]Pirita Studio Facebook[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/sFrt9aY5Kq]Mutropolis @ Application Systems Discord[/url]



[h3]MUTROPOLIS IS AT MAG 2020[/h3]

The good news doesn’t end here, Mutropolis is at MAG 2020! 
The MAG online community convention unites those from the field of cosplay, games, fashion and art and will be presented entirely online from 27th – 29th November. 

Take a look at the event, and join us for our livestream events found [url=https://mag-online.super-crowd.com/]here[/url]. 

We’re not alone, we’re also joined by other excellent Application Systems Heidelberg games:

[b]Growbot[/b] - A point-and-click adventure about a robot saving her home from a dark crystalline force. Set upon a biopunk space station bursting with fantastic plants and aliens.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661680/Growbot/]Store page here[/url]

[b]Ghost on the Shore[/b] - An exploration game about emotional ties that transcend even death. Riley is faced with a headstrong ghost, urging her on an adventure across atmospheric shores, uncovering the island's tragic secret. Choices in dialogue shape the bond between the two, ultimately deciding Riley's fate.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211930/Ghost_on_the_Shore/]Store page here[/url]

[b]Rosewater[/b] - a thrilling Western adventure set in an alternate 19th century. Harley Leger and her ragtag posse embark on a harrowing journey across Western Vespuccia, encountering bandits, rebels, visionaries, eccentrics, and many more friends and foes on their quest for fame and riches.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226670/Rosewater/]Store page here[/url]

[b]Haiki[/b] - Haiki is the BRUTAL precision platformer where decapitation is just the beginning! Dive head-first into four worlds of colour-switching, laser-dodging, lightning-fast action. Haiki is the platformer where you don't need a body to get ahead.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395270/Haiki/]Store page here[/url]


[h3]About Mutropolis[/h3]				
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.				
				
[h3]We are brodcasting: Mutropolis Dev insights & gameplay[/h3]				
Beatriz and Pablo (Pirita Studio) will have a chat with Volker (ASHGAMES). We introduce the team and talk about the inspiration and ideas behind Mutropolis. 
We show concept art and play the game a bit. A lot of behind the scenes content is waiting for you. 
				
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037120/Mutropolis//]Watch the broadcast on the store page[/url]

notes.title: WORKING FROM ISOLATION: AUGUST 2020 DEVLOG
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/6ee34b2a1d317b46f83b8bd99ccf35b1e1ba2bf6.gif[/img]

In the last few months, life seems to have paused.  Keeping social distance and having our masks ready to go, our little world as indie developers seems smaller than ever.
But in the solitude of our 2-person studio, with twitter and Skype as our only contact with the rest of the indie community, we continue to work at Mutropolis. Which, at least, makes us happy.
And we have a few news to share with all of you, readers of isolation!


[h2][b]VOICE OVER, BABY![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/e5c0f956fa78b218547462ce9367cf7040d6a954.jpg[/img]

We've finally started the voice-over of Mutropolis! We can't deny it' s one of the areas we've been waiting for with the most enthusiasm. It's exciting to give voices to your beloved characters and see them come to life. 
And thanks to the support of our Publisher, Application Systems Heidelberg, and our voiceover director, Alasdair Beckett-King, it is now a reality. We're still in the early stages, but we already have a pretty good idea of what Mutropolis will sound like - and it's lovely!
The casting has been an incredibly exciting, yet bittersweet experience. Especially if you have a delicate soul and hate having to make transcendental decisions (like having to choose between two very talented actors!). 
We couldn't be happier with the way things are going. We hope that in a very short time we can start showing Mutropolis full of voices and present our talented actors to you.

[h2][b]GAMESCOM ONLINE[/b][/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/5b6839661c974bdd69012fab6203bfe923efe043.jpg[/img]

No doubt more mixed feelings on this issue too! Pablo and I have been dreaming of going to Gamescom for years. We've come close to going on several occasions, but due to budget and/or schedule we hadn't been able to go. Ahem, yes. Mostly because of the budget. 

But, thanks to ASH, this was our year! It breaks our hearts not to be able to physically attend the event, but we will try to enjoy the online format to the fullest. 
Gamescom joins the list of events we've participated from the comfort of our homes, along with the Steam Summer Festival and EGX.
We're already working on what content we're going to show you. for more information, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Pirita_Studio]Twitter[/url].


[h2][b]AND NOW, WHAT?[/b][/h2]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34647064/3330a4ef1684a3eac60554f62ec11025dafe591a.jpg[/img]

There are already fewer milestones to reach before the release of the game.  
Last month we finished the English translation. As Spanish speakers, we had built the script of the game in Spanish. And while it's a pleasure to write in your native language, most players (obviously not Spanish speakers) would not be able to enjoy the nuances of the Spanish version. That's why ASH suggested that the English version of the game had to be more than just a hired translation. With the vital collaboration of Alasdair Beckett-King, we built an improved and fresh English version. 
We are currently working on fixing some unexpected bugs in the game's menus (they are always unexpected!), adding new graphics and optimizing performance.
We still have to start recording the voices, translate Mutropolis to other languages and start a last round of beta-testing. 
We hope to be able to give a release date soon!
